name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Provides income support of Rs 6000 per year to all landholding farmer families across India.
eligibility_text: farmer agriculture landholding rural male female cultivator small marginal farmer annual income below 200000 all states all categories SC ST OBC general age 18 and above
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year paid in 3 equal instalments of Rs 2,000 directly into bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a landholding farmer family
Land must be in the farmer's name
Annual family income should be below Rs 2 lakh
Not applicable to government employees, income taxpayers, or institutional landholders
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). You can also apply through your local patwari or agriculture officer.

name: PM Awas Yojana — Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides financial assistance to rural BPL households to construct pucca houses.
eligibility_text: rural housing BPL below poverty line low income poor homeless houseless SC ST OBC general annual income below 100000 rural areas all states farmer labourer unemployed
benefits: Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas for house construction. Also includes toilet construction support under SBM.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a rural household
Must be houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated house
Name must be in SECC 2011 data
Priority to SC/ST, minorities, and BPL families
how_to_apply: Apply through the Gram Panchayat or Block Development Officer. Selection is done from the SECC 2011 list. Contact your local panchayat for registration.

name: PM Awas Yojana — Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Provides housing for all in urban areas by 2022, offering interest subsidy on home loans for EWS/LIG/MIG categories.
eligibility_text: urban housing low income EWS LIG MIG economically weaker section lower income group annual income below 600000 urban slum dweller homeless houseless salaried self-employed all states
benefits: Interest subsidy of up to 6.5% on home loans for EWS/LIG. MIG-I gets 4% and MIG-II gets 3% subsidy. Also covers in-situ slum redevelopment.
eligibility_criteria: Must be an urban resident
EWS: Annual income up to Rs 3 lakh; LIG: up to Rs 6 lakh; MIG-I: up to Rs 12 lakh; MIG-II: up to Rs 18 lakh
Should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
First-time home buyer
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, housing finance companies, or at pmaymis.gov.in. You can also apply through your local Urban Local Body (ULB).

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Ensures access to financial services — banking, savings, credit, insurance and pension — for all unbanked citizens.
eligibility_text: unbanked financial inclusion low income rural urban poor all categories SC ST OBC general age 10 and above male female no bank account basic savings
benefits: Zero-balance savings account, RuPay debit card, Rs 1 lakh accident insurance cover, Rs 30,000 life insurance, overdraft facility up to Rs 10,000.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen aged 10 years or above
No existing bank account
Valid ID proof required
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or any government ID
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent (BC) outlet. Fill the account opening form and submit KYC documents. No minimum balance required.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: A government-backed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers guaranteeing a monthly pension after age 60.
eligibility_text: unorganized worker labourer age 18 to 40 pension retirement low income informal sector male female all categories SC ST OBC general bank account holder
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60 depending on contribution. Government co-contributes for eligible subscribers.
eligibility_criteria: Age between 18 and 40 years
Must have a savings bank account
Not a member of any statutory social security scheme
Not an income taxpayer
how_to_apply: Visit your bank branch or apply online through net banking. Fill the APY registration form and provide Aadhaar and bank details.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Low-cost life insurance scheme offering Rs 2 lakh life cover at just Rs 330 per year for bank account holders.
eligibility_text: life insurance low cost age 18 to 50 male female bank account low income all categories SC ST OBC general annual premium affordable
benefits: Rs 2 lakh life insurance cover on death from any cause. Premium of Rs 330 per year auto-debited from bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Age between 18 and 50 years
Must have a savings bank account
Must give consent for auto-debit of premium
how_to_apply: Apply at your bank branch or online through net banking. Submit the enrollment form and provide auto-debit consent.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Affordable accident insurance scheme offering Rs 2 lakh cover for accidental death and disability at only Rs 20 per year.
eligibility_text: accident insurance disability low cost age 18 to 70 male female bank account low income all categories SC ST OBC general affordable premium
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or permanent total disability. Rs 1 lakh for permanent partial disability. Premium of only Rs 20 per year.
eligibility_criteria: Age between 18 and 70 years
Must have a savings bank account
Must give consent for auto-debit of premium
how_to_apply: Apply at your bank branch or online through net banking. Submit the enrollment form and provide auto-debit consent.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing Rs 5 lakh health cover per year to poor and vulnerable families.
eligibility_text: health insurance hospitalization low income BPL poor family annual income below 100000 SC ST OBC general all states rural urban medical treatment hospital
benefits: Rs 5 lakh health cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization at empanelled hospitals. Cashless treatment.
eligibility_criteria: Must be listed in SECC 2011 data
Includes deprived rural families and identified occupational categories in urban areas
No cap on family size or age
Pre-existing diseases covered from day one
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555. Visit nearest Common Service Centre or empanelled hospital to get Golden Card.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education.
eligibility_text: SC scheduled caste student post matriculation education scholarship college university annual income below 250000 male female age 14 to 30
benefits: Maintenance allowance, study tour charges, thesis typing/printing charges, book allowance, and other allowances depending on course level.
eligibility_criteria: Must belong to Scheduled Caste category
Studying in post-matriculation or post-secondary stage
Annual parental/guardian income should not exceed Rs 2.5 lakh
Must be a regular student
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal). Register, fill application form, upload documents and submit before the deadline.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
description: Scholarship for minority community students studying in Class 1 to Class 10 to support their education.
eligibility_text: minority Muslim Christian Sikh Buddhist Parsi student pre matric scholarship school class 1 to 10 annual income below 100000 male female age 6 to 16
benefits: Admission fee, tuition fee, maintenance allowance for day scholars and hostellers. Day scholars get Rs 500/month and hostellers get Rs 1,000/month.
eligibility_criteria: Must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain)
Studying in Class 1 to 10
Annual family income below Rs 1 lakh
Must have secured at least 50% marks in previous class
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal) during the application window, usually July to October.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: A savings scheme for the girl child to meet education and marriage expenses, offering high interest rate with tax benefits.
eligibility_text: girl child daughter female education marriage savings parents guardian age below 10 all categories SC ST OBC general low income middle income
benefits: Interest rate of 8.2% per annum (revised quarterly). Tax deduction under Section 80C. Maturity amount tax-free. Partial withdrawal allowed for education.
eligibility_criteria: Account can be opened for a girl child below 10 years of age
Maximum two accounts per family (one per girl child)
Must be opened by parent or legal guardian
Minimum deposit Rs 250 per year
how_to_apply: Open an account at any post office or authorized bank branch. Fill the SSY account opening form and make initial deposit (minimum Rs 250).

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit scheme providing cash incentive to pregnant and lactating women for the first living child.
eligibility_text: pregnant lactating women maternity first child female age 19 and above low income all categories SC ST OBC general rural urban
benefits: Cash benefit of Rs 5,000 in three instalments for the first living child. Additional benefit under JSY for institutional delivery.
eligibility_criteria: Pregnant and lactating women aged 19 years and above
For the first living child only
Must not be in regular employment with the central or state government
Must register at Anganwadi Centre
how_to_apply: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility. Fill Form 1-A for registration within the prescribed time.

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA (MGNREGS)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
eligibility_text: rural employment unskilled manual labour adult male female age 18 and above rural household low income all categories SC ST OBC general unemployed labourer
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per household per year. Wages paid as per state schedule. Unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a rural household
Adult members (18 years and above) willing to do unskilled manual work
Must have a job card issued by Gram Panchayat
required_documents: Bank account or post office account details
how_to_apply: Register at the Gram Panchayat office to get a Job Card. Once registered, apply for work in writing or orally to the Gram Panchayat.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
description: Provides financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials and market entry.
eligibility_text: startup entrepreneur self-employed business innovation age 18 and above male female all categories SC ST OBC general urban rural technology product
benefits: Up to Rs 20 lakh for proof of concept, prototype and product trials. Up to Rs 50 lakh for market entry and commercialization as convertible debentures or debt.
eligibility_criteria: DPIIT recognized startup
Incorporated not more than 2 years ago
Should not have received more than Rs 10 lakh of monetary support from Government
Should not have received funding from venture capital fund
how_to_apply: Apply online at seedfund.startupindia.gov.in. Select an incubator, fill the application form and submit required documents.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
eligibility_text: SC ST women entrepreneur self-employed business loan female SC scheduled caste ST scheduled tribe age 18 and above greenfield enterprise manufacturing services trading
benefits: Bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services or trading sector.
eligibility_criteria: SC/ST or woman borrower
Age 18 years and above
Setting up a greenfield enterprise
In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding by SC/ST or woman
how_to_apply: Apply online at standupmitra.in or visit any scheduled commercial bank branch. Register on the portal and connect with a handholding agency if needed.

name: PM MUDRA Yojana
description: Provides loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises through banks, MFIs and NBFCs.
eligibility_text: small business micro enterprise self-employed low income non-farm entrepreneur male female all categories SC ST OBC general annual income below 1000000 shop vendor trader
benefits: Shishu: loans up to Rs 50,000. Kishor: Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh. Tarun: Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh. No collateral required for Shishu loans.
eligibility_criteria: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises
Business activities in manufacturing, trading, services sector
No collateral required
Indian citizen above 18 years
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch, MFI or NBFC. Alternatively visit mudra.org.in. Fill loan application with business details and required documents.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for elderly citizens belonging to BPL families.
eligibility_text: elderly old age senior citizen age 60 and above BPL below poverty line low income male female all categories SC ST OBC general pension monthly
benefits: Rs 200 per month for persons aged 60-79 years. Rs 500 per month for persons aged 80 years and above.
eligibility_criteria: Age 60 years and above
Must belong to a BPL household
Should not be receiving pension from any other source
required_documents: Age proof (birth certificate or school certificate)
how_to_apply: Apply at the District Social Welfare Office or Gram Panchayat. Submit the application form with required documents. Block/tehsil office processes the application.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Monthly pension for widows belonging to BPL families.
eligibility_text: widow widowed woman female age 40 to 79 BPL below poverty line low income pension monthly social security all categories SC ST OBC general
benefits: Rs 300 per month as monthly pension directly transferred to bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Widow aged between 40 and 79 years
Must belong to a BPL household
Should not be receiving pension from any other government source
how_to_apply: Apply at the District Social Welfare Office or Gram Panchayat. Submit the application form with widowhood proof and BPL certificate.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly pension for persons with severe or multiple disabilities belonging to BPL families.
eligibility_text: disability disabled differently abled severe multiple disability age 18 to 79 BPL below poverty line low income all categories SC ST OBC general pension monthly
benefits: Rs 300 per month as monthly pension for persons with 80% or more disability.
eligibility_criteria: Age between 18 and 79 years
Severe or multiple disabilities (80% or more)
Must belong to a BPL household
Should not be receiving any other pension
how_to_apply: Apply at the District Social Welfare Office or Gram Panchayat. Submit disability certificate issued by authorized medical authority along with BPL certificate.

name: Assistance to Disabled Persons (ADIP) Scheme
description: Provides assistive devices and aids to persons with disabilities to enhance their mobility, communication and daily activities.
eligibility_text: disability disabled differently abled assistive device aid appliance hearing aid wheelchair low income annual income below 200000 male female all categories SC ST OBC general
benefits: Free assistive devices such as tricycles, wheelchairs, crutches, hearing aids, artificial limbs, Braille kits, smart phones for blind, etc.
eligibility_criteria: Indian citizen with disability of 40% or more
Annual income below Rs 20,000 per month (Rs 2.4 lakh per year)
For children: age below 5 years not eligible for some devices
Device must be required as recommended by medical authority
how_to_apply: Apply through implementing agencies such as ALIMCO, NHFDC, or NGOs approved by Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. Camps are organized regularly.

name: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate employment through establishment of micro enterprises in rural and urban areas.
eligibility_text: unemployed self-employment micro enterprise business loan age 18 and above male female SC ST OBC general rural urban annual income any subsidy
benefits: Subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost depending on category and location. Maximum project cost Rs 25 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 10 lakh for service sector.
eligibility_criteria: Age 18 years and above
At least VIII standard pass for projects above Rs 10 lakh
New enterprises only (not for existing units)
Preference to SC/ST, women, ex-servicemen, differently abled
how_to_apply: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal. Fill the application form, select a bank, upload documents. District KVIC/KVIB/DIC office processes the application.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Provides short-term formal credit to farmers for their cultivation and other needs at subsidized interest rates.
eligibility_text: farmer agriculture credit loan fisherman animal husbandry cultivator male female all categories SC ST OBC general annual income any rural
benefits: Revolving credit facility at interest rate of 7% per annum (with 3% interest subvention, effective rate 4%). Credit limit based on land holding and crops.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers — individual or joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
Tenant farmers, oral lessees and share croppers
Self help groups or joint liability groups of farmers
Fishermen and those engaged in animal husbandry
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch or cooperative bank. Fill the KCC application form and submit land records and identity proof. Bank disburses credit within 14 days.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.
eligibility_text: farmer agriculture crop insurance natural calamity flood drought crop loss all categories SC ST OBC general rural cultivator male female
benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance covering crop loss from sowing to post-harvest. Premium as low as 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for horticulture crops.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers growing notified crops
Compulsory for loanee farmers; voluntary for non-loanee farmers
Covers crop loss due to non-preventable natural risks
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, insurance companies, or Common Service Centres. Loanee farmers are enrolled automatically. Visit pmfby.gov.in for more information.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
description: Scheme to address declining child sex ratio and promote welfare and education of the girl child.
eligibility_text: girl child daughter female education school parent guardian low income all categories SC ST OBC general rural urban awareness campaign
benefits: Promotes education of girl child. Financial incentives through linked schemes like Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana. Conditional cash transfers in select states.
eligibility_criteria: Primarily targets parents/guardians of girl children
Focused on districts with low Child Sex Ratio
No direct income or caste restriction
how_to_apply: Awareness and advocacy scheme. Financial benefits accessed through linked schemes. Contact Anganwadi Centre or local Women and Child Development office for guidance.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Provides financial support to employers engaging apprentices and stipend support to apprentices for skill development.
eligibility_text: youth apprentice skill training vocational age 14 to 35 male female all categories SC ST OBC general unemployed technical diploma ITI
benefits: 25% of stipend reimbursed to employers (up to Rs 1,500 per month). Basic training cost reimbursed up to Rs 7,500 per apprentice.
eligibility_criteria: Age between 14 and 35 years (18 for hazardous occupations)
Minimum educational qualification as per trade
Must not be a full-time student
Must register on apprenticeship portal
how_to_apply: Register at apprenticeshipindia.org. Select trade and employer, apply for apprenticeship. Can also approach nearby ITI or employer directly.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: Scholarship for Other Backward Class students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education.
eligibility_text: OBC other backward class student post matriculation scholarship college university annual income below 100000 male female age 14 to 30 education
benefits: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of tuition fees and other non-refundable charges for OBC students.
eligibility_criteria: Must belong to OBC category
Studying in post-matriculation or post-secondary stage
Annual parental income should not exceed Rs 1 lakh
Must be a regular student in a recognized institution
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal) during the application window. Register, fill form, upload documents.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students pursuing post-matriculation education to prevent dropout and ensure higher education.
eligibility_text: ST scheduled tribe student post matriculation education scholarship college university annual income below 250000 male female age 14 to 30 tribal
benefits: Maintenance allowance, tuition and other fees reimbursement, book allowance, and other benefits for ST students.
eligibility_criteria: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe category
Studying in post-matriculation or post-secondary stage
Annual parental income should not exceed Rs 2.5 lakh
Must be a regular student
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal) during the application window.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Issues soil health cards to farmers carrying crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers for individual farms.
eligibility_text: farmer agriculture soil health card fertilizer nutrient all categories SC ST OBC general rural male female cultivator landholding
benefits: Free soil testing and soil health card with crop-wise fertilizer recommendations. Helps reduce input costs and improve crop yield.
eligibility_criteria: Any farmer with agricultural land
No income or category restriction
Covers all states and union territories
how_to_apply: Contact your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), Agriculture Department office, or soil testing laboratory. Alternatively visit soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

name: PM Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces
description: Scholarships for wards of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) and Railway Protection Force (RPF) personnel.
eligibility_text: student scholarship CAPF central armed police forces RPF railway protection force ward son daughter ex-serviceman deceased serving male female all categories annual income any
benefits: Rs 2,500 per month for boys and Rs 3,000 per month for girls pursuing first professional degree courses.
eligibility_criteria: Wards of CAPF (BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB, NIA, NSG, AR) and RPF personnel
Priority to wards of deceased/disabled personnel
Pursuing first professional degree course
Minimum 60% marks in qualifying examination
how_to_apply: Apply online at ksb.gov.in (Kendriya Sainik Board) or the respective CAPF force website during the application window.

name: PM Rozgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)
description: Government pays EPF employer contribution for new employees to incentivize formal employment generation.
eligibility_text: salaried employee formal employment EPF EPFO registered new worker age 18 and above male female all categories SC ST OBC general monthly salary below 15000
benefits: Government pays 8.33% EPS and 3.67% EPF employer contribution for 3 years for new employees with monthly salary up to Rs 15,000.
eligibility_criteria: New employee registered with EPFO for the first time
Monthly salary up to Rs 15,000
Employer must be registered with EPFO
Valid Aadhaar-seeded UAN
how_to_apply: Employer registers on pmrpy.gov.in and links existing EPFO account. Employee enrollment is automatic once employer registers for the scheme.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Online trading platform for agricultural commodities connecting farmers directly to buyers across India.
eligibility_text: farmer agriculture market selling trading crop commodity male female all categories SC ST OBC general rural produce online market
benefits: Access to larger market across states, better price discovery, transparent auctioning, and direct payment to bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Any registered farmer with agricultural produce
Must register at the nearest APMC mandi
No minimum quantity restriction
Applicable in states where APMCs are linked to e-NAM
how_to_apply: Register at nearest Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) mandi linked to e-NAM. Can also register online at enam.gov.in.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
description: Provides lump-sum family benefit to BPL households on death of the primary breadwinner.
eligibility_text: BPL below poverty line low income death breadwinner family male female all categories SC ST OBC general rural urban social security lump sum
benefits: One-time lump sum amount of Rs 20,000 to the bereaved household on death of breadwinner.
eligibility_criteria: Household must be below poverty line (BPL)
Death of primary breadwinner aged between 18 and 64 years
Application must be made within 90 days of death
how_to_apply: Apply at the District Social Welfare Office or Gram Panchayat within 90 days of death. Submit application with all required documents.

name: PM Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
description: Provides all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations to support rural development.
eligibility_text: rural village habitation connectivity road infrastructure all categories SC ST OBC general BPL low income farmer labourer rural development
benefits: All-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations. Improves access to markets, schools, hospitals and reduces isolation.
eligibility_criteria: Unconnected rural habitations with population 500+ in plain areas
Population 250+ in North-East, Hill States, Tribal and Desert areas
Scheme is for habitations, not individuals
how_to_apply: This is a community-level infrastructure scheme. Individual citizens cannot directly apply. Contact your Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office to raise demand.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Skill training and placement programme for rural youth to enable livelihood through wage employment.
eligibility_text: rural youth skill training placement wage employment age 15 to 35 male female SC ST OBC general BPL low income unemployed vocational
benefits: Free skill training, placement assistance, post-placement support, and migration support. Training in various industry-relevant trades.
eligibility_criteria: Rural youth aged 15 to 35 years
Age relaxation up to 45 years for women and special groups
Must be rural household member
Priority to SC/ST, BPL families and minorities
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest DDU-GKY training centre or through the Gram Panchayat. Find training centres at ddugky.gov.in.
